# Implement an approved milestone

Read [the repository instructions](../../AGENTS.md), the
[approved specification index](../../docs/specs/spec-000-milestone-index.md),
and the applicable milestone specification.
Use the [add-feature workflow](../skills/add-feature/SKILL.md).

Before you edit, identify the dependencies and the acceptance criteria.
Make the full approved scope.
Keep the specifications, source code, tests, documentation, and production evidence in agreement.

Run the tests for the changed behavior.
Run `npm run quality:quick` for the usual validation.
Run the full gate only when the user tells you directly to use the full quality-gate skill.
Keep work that is not related to the task.
In the report, give all blocked evidence and all manual evidence.
